edits.why: Header names the system the canvas uses.
Tokens come from maude-v2. Every token this canvas and RepoBranchSwitcher.css use exists in maude-v2 under the same name.
Shared component classes come from maude-v2.

notes: Decision: .panel (1 use, panel rb-mini) → closest is .island; .tree-row (5 uses) → closest is .row-item. Neither has a maude-v2 rule; the local rb- classes keep them visible.
Buttons (btn, btn--primary, btn--ghost, btn--sm) and .input all exist in maude-v2: no change needed. The on-draft fold-back CTA keeps its filled accent.
Line heights change from fixed px to ratios (RepoBranchSwitcher.css uses --lh-* four times): the compact one-line dock trigger should be checked after the switch.
maude-v2's :root default is light; every artboard sets data-theme="dark" explicitly, so it stays dark.

Comments only: RepoBranchSwitcher.css line 5 and the TSX docblock still mention system/maude. The design is 'handed-off' (handoffCommit 8e9758e); RepoBranchSwitcher.registry.json describes the maude build until the handoff is redone.
